name: yourcounselor-dev-harness
description: Local browser test console for the YourCounselor Python backend. Not deployed. Holds no secrets.
_readme: Run the backend (npm run backend:dev, needs the Python deps from requirements.txt) then the console (npm run harness) and open http://localhost:5173. The harness proxies /v1 and /healthz to the backend and injects a dev token; the browser holds no key. The real app is Android talking to the Python backend directly — this is a developer convenience only.
